skew.note: Fitted on nflverse 2018-2023 weekly stats, tested out of sample on 2024-2026.

key_numbers.verdict: adopted as game-card guidance: buy onto/off 3 and 7 only, at -120 or better; skip other half-points

backtest.verdict: adopted for Questionable players: snap haircut feeds the sim, play probability shown on cards; Wed-Thu-Fri trend is logged daily and shown info-only until a season of daily history exists

garbage_time.rule: Q4 plays with offense win probability under 5% or over 95%
garbage_time.verdict: info-only: did not beat full-game baselines out of sample (props settle on full games)

epa.verdict: info-only: no out-of-sample ATS or total edge over closing lines
epa.filter: non-garbage plays (drops Q4 snaps with win probability under 5% or over 95%)
